text:
[Council File 26-1554]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to instructing Community Investment Department (CID) to report to Council on the prevalence of ghost job postings in Los Angeles; a review of policy responses in other jurisdictions; creating a "job posting transparency standard."
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Hutt - Soto-Martinez):
INSTRUCT the CID to report to Council within 90 days on the prevalence of ghost job postings in Los Angeles, including: estimates based on available datasets; analysis of sectors most affected, and impacts on job seekers in Los Angeles. This should include a review of policy responses in other jurisdictions, including Ontario, New York, Pennsylvania, California, New Jersey, and Kentucky, and an assessment of which approaches may be feasible or advisable for the City of Los Angeles which could include creating a local (voluntary) "job posting transparency standard" for employers with 25 employees or more.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council instructs the Community Investment Department to report within 90 days on how common ghost job postings are in Los Angeles and on policy options from other jurisdictions, including a possible voluntary job posting transparency standard for employers with 25 or more employees.
